page.overview:
Who is Nine Historians?

The were a group of historians that disappeared in 12335 AG. Other scholars, seeking what happened to the historians, asked God Emperor Leto Atreides II of their whereabouts. Leto told them the historians were executed by the for 'lying pretentiously'.

They were knocked out and then burned on pyres of their own written works. Leto later defended his actions to Moneo Atreides, claiming that, as they were rendered unconscious, 'The historians died peacefully. Not a one felt the flames'.
